software_detail: ROSY (Brennan et al. 1999) for published EU/LU/CU ages; DATA (Grün 2009) also run, 'results similar to ROSY for EU and LU' (no DATA ages printed)

conventions.cosmic: 190 uGy/a (printed 'mGy/y'), Prescott & Hutton (1994) for latitude, longitude and depth
conventions.gamma_source: computed from soil U/Th (NAA) and K (AAS); alpha from soil neglected (~500 um outer layer removed)

samples.provenance: Table 4 (De, ages) and Table 5 (U, Th; NAA) row Artiodactyla; p. 205
samples.notes: K in enamel and dentine 'ND' (not determined). Th '<0.01' marked with asterisk = below detection limit. CU = LU enamel + EU dentine (stated). Which sediment values (individual or mean of the three soil samples) entered ROSY is not stated.
